Dated this the 22nd day of November, 2017  JUDGMENT Ext.P16 is a representation preferred by the petitioner before the respondent seeking permission to make use of the water available to them in terms of Ext.P10 order for the industrial activity undertaken by them.

The limited prayer made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, when this matter was taken up for admission, is for a direction to the respondent to take a decision on Ext.P16 representation within a time frame.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner.
3.
In the nature of the order I propose to pass in the writ petition, notice to the respondent is not necessary and the same is, accordingly, dispensed with.

Having regard to the prayer made in Ext.P16 representation, I deem it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition directing the respondent to take a decision on Ext.P16, within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
Ordered accordingly.
Needless to say that the petitioner shall be given an opportunity of hearing before the direction aforesaid is complied with.
